options.text: An SNS topic whose subscription endpoint is supplied by a template parameter named WorkQueue.
An SNS topic with a policy permitting SQS subscriptions, but without creating a subscription.
An SNS topic and a new SQS queue that is created by executing the GetAtt expression.
An SNS topic with an SQS subscription whose endpoint is the ARN of the WorkQueue resource.

explanation.text:
<<4>> is correct. The Subscription property declares an endpoint for the topic. Protocol: sqs selects an SQS subscription, and GetAtt resolves the Arn attribute of the queue resource identified by WorkQueue.

<<1>> confuses a resource attribute with a template parameter. <<2>> treats a subscription declaration as an access policy; the fragment actually declares a subscription. <<3>> treats GetAtt as a queue-creation operation. The separate AWS::SQS::Queue declaration creates the queue, while GetAtt retrieves an attribute after the resource is available.

For this resource, Ref returns the queue URL, while GetAtt WorkQueue.Arn returns the ARN required by the SNS endpoint. Successful message delivery also requires a queue policy allowing SNS to send messages from the intended topic. That permission is separate from the subscription shown here.

sources.supports: GetAtt resolves an attribute of a declared resource.
The topic Subscription property declares subscription endpoints.
SQS Ref returns a URL and GetAtt Arn returns the queue ARN.
SNS delivery to SQS requires a queue policy permitting SendMessage from the topic.
